findings: 2026-11-06: drafted for Mathematics 12 Unit 1 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.

Book correction: The Recall! box prints the second-last term as a_{1}x and the word 'where' as 'whe'. The coefficients run a_{0}, a_{1}, \ldots, a_{n-1}, a_{n}, so the term before a_{n} is a_{n-1}x (a_{1} is already the coefficient of x^{n-1}). Correct: P(x) = a_{0}x^{n} + a_{1}x^{n-1} + \cdots + a_{n-2}x^{2} + a_{n-1}x + a_{n} is a polynomial of degree n, where n is a non-negative integer and a_{0} \ne 0.
